_what: Deploy canary. Bump `marker` and push. If the live URL shows the new value, the GitHub to Vercel pipeline is firing. If it shows the old value or 404s, it is not.
_why_public: Files in public/ are copied verbatim to the build output, so this proves the pipeline ran WITHOUT depending on any app code. Vercel checks the filesystem before applying the SPA rewrite in vercel.json, so a real file at this path wins over the /index.html catch-all.
_scope: Proves a DEPLOY happened. It does not prove the BUILD compiled new source, because static files are copied, not compiled. For that, trigger the exam crash and look for the 'Technical details' panel on the error screen.
_safe_to_delete: Yes. Nothing imports it and no route references it.
note: bump marker to canary-002, canary-003 ... on each test push
